representation.name: OpenSpliceAI v0.0.5 OSAIMANE-10000nt ensemble prediction
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
mkdir -p deps modeldir prediction
cp "$(inputs.package.path)" openspliceai-0.0.5-py3-none-any.whl
cp "$(inputs.h5pywheel.path)" h5py-3.11.0-cp310-cp310-manylinux_2_17_x86_64.manylinux2014_x86_64.whl
cp "$(inputs.biopythonwheel.path)" biopython-1.83-cp310-cp310-manylinux_2_17_x86_64.manylinux2014_x86_64.whl
cp "$(inputs.gffutilswheel.path)" gffutils-0.13-py3-none-any.whl
cp "$(inputs.pyfaidxwheel.path)" pyfaidx-0.9.0.4-py3-none-any.whl
cp "$(inputs.arghwheel.path)" argh-0.31.3-py3-none-any.whl
cp "$(inputs.argcompletewheel.path)" argcomplete-3.7.2-py3-none-any.whl
cp "$(inputs.simplejsonwheel.path)" simplejson-4.1.2-cp310-cp310-manylinux1_x86_64.manylinux_2_28_x86_64.manylinux_2_5_x86_64.whl
cp "$(inputs.packagingwheel.path)" packaging-26.3-py3-none-any.whl
python -m pip install --no-deps --target deps openspliceai-0.0.5-py3-none-any.whl h5py-3.11.0-cp310-cp310-manylinux_2_17_x86_64.manylinux2014_x86_64.whl biopython-1.83-cp310-cp310-manylinux_2_17_x86_64.manylinux2014_x86_64.whl gffutils-0.13-py3-none-any.whl pyfaidx-0.9.0.4-py3-none-any.whl argh-0.31.3-py3-none-any.whl argcomplete-3.7.2-py3-none-any.whl simplejson-4.1.2-cp310-cp310-manylinux1_x86_64.manylinux_2_28_x86_64.manylinux_2_5_x86_64.whl packaging-26.3-py3-none-any.whl
cp "$(inputs.model10.path)" modeldir/model_10000nt_rs10.pt
cp "$(inputs.model11.path)" modeldir/model_10000nt_rs11.pt
cp "$(inputs.model12.path)" modeldir/model_10000nt_rs12.pt
cp "$(inputs.model13.path)" modeldir/model_10000nt_rs13.pt
cp "$(inputs.model14.path)" modeldir/model_10000nt_rs14.pt
PYTHONPATH=deps python deps/bin/openspliceai predict --model modeldir --input-sequence "$(inputs.sequence.path)" --flanking-size 10000 --threshold 0.9 --output-dir prediction --debug
